name: Clomipramine
mechanism: Potent serotonin reuptake inhibition with additional noradrenaline reuptake inhibition; anticholinergic and antihistamine effects
dosing: OCD: start 25 mg nocte, increase every 3-4 days to 100-150 mg/day; max 250 mg/day. Depression: 25 mg BD-TDS, titrate to 100-150 mg/day.
contraindications: Recent MI, arrhythmias, mania, severe liver disease, narrow-angle glaucoma, concurrent MAOI use
interactions: Alcohol (↑ sedation), QT-prolonging drugs, SSRIs/serotonergic agents (serotonin syndrome), CYP2D6 inhibitors (↑ levels)
monitoring: ECG before and during titration if cardiac risk; suicide risk (esp <25 years); anticholinergic effects
pregnancy: Use with caution; neonatal withdrawal possible
sideEffects: Sedation, dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention, orthostatic hypotension, QT prolongation, sexual dysfunction, seizures in overdose
pharmacokinetics: Hepatic metabolism (CYP2D6); active metabolite desmethylclomipramine; t½ 19-37 h
clinicalPearls: Most serotonergic TCA; effective for OCD when SSRIs inadequate. Cardiotoxic in overdose—dispense small quantities.
